lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg14Ga2 (Mg7Ga) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing 16 atoms and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all Ga and Mg centers in close-packed-like local arrangements with 12 geometric neighbors each, at distances of 3.05–3.31 Å; the Mg environments include mixed Mg/Ga coordination. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Mg-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, plus edge-sharing between Ga- and Mg-centered polyhedra.
